title: 🌱 Vikram's plant experiment proved nothing... the control pot he skipped #science #experiment
title_alts: 🔬 Vikram's control pot is the boring half... it decides the result #science #experiment
🪴 Vikram skipped the control group... his plant result proved nothing #science #experiment
description_hook: Vikram measured nine centimetres of growth and thought he had proof. The pot he never planted was the whole experiment.
setting: a home windowsill lined with seedling pots

characters.name: Vikram
characters.description: eleven years old, short black hair, grey school t-shirt, a metal ruler always in his pocket

claims.basis: round illustrative setup size, stated as such in the narration
round illustrative duration for a bean seedling trial
round illustrative measurement, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: Six pots with music, six in silence
claims.basis: round illustrative setup size, stated as such in the narration
round illustrative measurement, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: Nine against eight is one centimetre
claims.basis: arithmetic on the two illustrative figures already stated

scenes.narration: Half of a good experiment is the pot you ignore.
scenes.caption: अच्थे प्रयोग का आधा हिस्सा वही गमला है जिसे आप नज़रअंदाज़ करते हैं
scenes.image_brief: One empty terracotta pot filled with flat dark soil, standing alone at the front of a pale wooden table, no seedling in it, a blank white sticker on its rim, a row of leafy bean pots further back on the same table, cool morning light from a side window, still and overlooked.

scenes.narration: Vikram played music to six bean seedlings for two weeks.
scenes.caption: विक्रम ने छह बीन के पौधों को दो हफ़्ते तक संगीत सुनाया
scenes.image_brief: Six small terracotta pots of young bean seedlings in a straight row on a wooden windowsill, a small black portable speaker standing at the end of the row, two broad green leaves on every stem, warm daylight coming through the glass behind them.

scenes.narration: They grew nine centimetres. He wrote that music helps plants.
scenes.caption: वे नौ सेंटीमीटर बढ़े। उसने लिखा कि संगीत पौधों की मदद करता है
scenes.image_brief: A metal ruler standing upright in the soil beside one bean seedling on a wooden table, the top leaves reaching the nine centimetre mark, an open paper notebook with pencilled numbers lying flat next to the pot, bright afternoon light from the window.

scenes.narration: By the end you will know why that sentence proves nothing.
scenes.caption: आख़िर तक आप समझ जाऐंगे कि यह वाक्य कुछ भी साबित नहीं करता
scenes.image_brief: Two identical bean seedlings in terracotta pots side by side on a windowsill, a small speaker beside the left pot and bare sill beside the right pot, both plants the same height with the same number of leaves, even soft daylight, calm and comparative.

scenes.narration: Seedlings grow anyway. Light, water and warmth already push them upward.
scenes.caption: पौधे तो बढ़ते ही हैं। रोशनी, पानी और गर्मी उन्हें ऊपर उठाती है
scenes.image_brief: A single bean seedling in a terracotta pot on a sunlit windowsill with a small watering can and a thermometer standing beside it, sunlight falling straight across the leaves, a faint damp ring on the sill, warm and ordinary.

scenes.narration: So growth alone cannot separate the music from the sunshine.
scenes.caption: इसलिए बढ़ना अकेले संगीत और धूप का फ़र्क़ नहीं बता सकता
scenes.image_brief: One tall bean seedling in a pot standing between a dark silent speaker and a bright open window, strong sunlight flooding the leaves from the window side, the speaker sitting in shadow, midday light across the wooden sill.

scenes.narration: He starts again. Six pots with music, six in silence.
scenes.caption: वह दोबारा शुरू करता है। छह गमले संगीत के साथ, छह बिना आवाज़
scenes.image_brief: Twelve identical small terracotta pots of bean seedlings arranged in two groups of six on a long wooden bench, a black speaker set in front of the left group and nothing in front of the right group, soft even daylight from a large window.

scenes.narration: Same soil, same window, same water. Silent pots reached eight centimetres.
scenes.caption: वही मिट्टी, वही खिड़की, वही पानी। चुप गमले आठ सेंटीमीटर पहुँचे
scenes.image_brief: Two bean seedlings taken from different groups placed side by side on a wooden bench with a metal ruler standing upright between them, the left plant slightly taller than the right, identical pots and identical damp soil, clear daylight.

scenes.narration: Nine against eight is one centimetre. That gap means nothing here.
scenes.caption: नौ बनाम आठ यानी एक सेंटीमीटर। यहाँ यह अंतर कुछ नहीं कहता
scenes.image_brief: A metal ruler laid against the stems of two bean seedlings of nearly equal height on a bench, their leaf tips almost level with barely a centimetre between them, flat overcast light through a window, unremarkable and inconclusive.

scenes.narration: With only six pots, ordinary variation swamps a difference that small.
scenes.caption: सिर्फ़ छह गमलों में आम उतार-चढ़ाव इतना छोटा अंतर निगल जाता है
scenes.image_brief: Six bean seedlings in identical pots on one wooden bench at visibly uneven heights, two long and leggy, two short and stocky, one leaning sideways, all in the same damp soil under the same plain daylight, messy and inconsistent.

scenes.narration: The forgotten pot was never wasted space. It was the measurement.
scenes.caption: वह भूला हुआ गमला बेकार जगह नहीं था। वही असली माप था
scenes.image_brief: The plain unlabelled pot of bare soil now standing in the middle of a row of leafy bean seedling pots on a wooden bench, warm late afternoon light raking across the soil surface, quietly central.

scenes.narration: Every result needs something boring to be compared against.
scenes.caption: हर नतीजे को तुलना के लिए कोई बोरिंग चीज़ चाहिए होती है
scenes.image_brief: Two wooden benches of identical bean seedling pots facing each other across a bright room, a speaker standing beside one bench and the other bench bare, the same window light reaching both rows.

scenes.narration: Next experiment, set up the boring pot first. Then change one thing.
scenes.caption: अगले प्रयोग में पहले बोरिंग गमला लगाएँ। फिर एक ही चीज़ बदलें
scenes.image_brief: An empty terracotta pot, an open bag of dark soil, a paper packet of bean seeds and a sharpened pencil laid out in a line on a clean wooden table, bright morning light, everything ready and unused.

title: 🥚 Nikhil's egg lost its shell overnight... then day two stalled #science #chemistry
title_alts: 🧪 Nikhil's vinegar egg shows acid at work... and when it quits #science #chemistry
🍳 Nikhil left the old vinegar in... why his shell stopped dissolving #science #chemistry
description_hook: An egg in vinegar loses its shell, then seems to give up halfway. Nothing failed, the acid simply ran out.
setting: a dark stone kitchen counter holding glasses of vinegar

characters.name: Nikhil
characters.description: twelve years old, curly hair, striped blue apron too big for him, one chipped front tooth

claims.claim: At twenty-four hours the shell felt soft
claims.basis: round illustrative timing for a vinegar and eggshell demonstration

claims.claim: By forty-eight hours the egg was bare and rubbery
claims.basis: round illustrative timing, stated as such in the narration

scenes.narration: A raw egg can lose its whole shell without cracking.
scenes.caption: कच्चा अंडा अपना पूरा छिलका खो सकता है, बिना टूटे
scenes.image_brief: A single raw white egg resting on a dark stone kitchen counter beside a tall bottle of white vinegar, the shell smooth and completely intact, cool daylight arriving from a kitchen window on the left.

scenes.narration: Nikhil slid one egg into a tall glass of white vinegar.
scenes.caption: निखिल ने एक अंडा सफ़ेद सिरके के ऊँचे ग्लास में रखा
scenes.image_brief: A tall clear drinking glass on a dark stone counter filled with pale white vinegar, one whole white egg settling at the bottom of it, the vinegar bottle standing just behind the glass, bright kitchen light.

scenes.narration: Bubbles swarmed the shell within a minute, so he left it overnight.
scenes.caption: एक मिनट में छिलके पर बुलबुले छा गए, तो उसने रातभर छोड़ दिया
scenes.image_brief: The tall glass of vinegar on the dark counter with the submerged white egg completely coated in tiny clinging bubbles, a thin ring of foam gathering at the vinegar surface, warm evening kitchen light.

scenes.narration: You will learn why the second day is where most attempts stall.
scenes.caption: आप जानेंगे कि दूसरे दिन ही ज़्यादातर कोशिशें क्यों रुक जाती हैं
scenes.image_brief: Two identical tall glasses of vinegar standing side by side on the dark counter, each holding one white egg, the left glass clear and lively with bubbles and the right glass murky and still, flat morning light.

scenes.narration: Vinegar is a weak acid. An eggshell is mostly calcium carbonate.
scenes.caption: सिरका हल्का अम्ल है। अंडे का छिलका ज़्यादातर कैल्शियम कार्बोनेट है
scenes.image_brief: Dry broken pieces of chalky white eggshell scattered on a dark stone counter next to a small open bottle of white vinegar, the fragments pale and porous, plain even daylight.

scenes.narration: The acid strips that carbonate off and fizzes it away as carbon dioxide.
scenes.caption: अम्ल उस कार्बोनेट को छीनता है और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड बनाकर उड़ा देता है
scenes.image_brief: Columns of small gas bubbles breaking free from a softening eggshell and rising through slightly cloudy vinegar inside a tall glass on a dark counter, a chalky white haze drifting near the glass bottom, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: At twenty-four hours the shell felt soft, patchy and still stubbornly grey.
scenes.caption: चौबीस घंटे में छिलका नरम और जगह-जगह घिसा था, पर अब भी स्लेटी
scenes.image_brief: A tall glass of murky grey vinegar on the dark counter, the egg inside swollen with a dull patchy surface where soft shell still clings, loose flecks of shell resting on the glass bottom, dim morning light.

scenes.narration: Nikhil poured in fresh vinegar. By forty-eight hours the egg was bare and rubbery.
scenes.caption: निखिल ने ताज़ा सिरका डाला। अड़तालीस घंटे में अंडा नंगा और रबर जैसा था
scenes.image_brief: A bare translucent rubbery egg resting on the dark stone counter beside an empty rinsed glass and an open bottle of fresh vinegar, the yellow yolk faintly visible through the stretched membrane, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Old vinegar is finished, its acid already spent on the first shell.
scenes.caption: पुराना सिरका ख़त्म है, उसका अम्ल पहले छिलके पर लग चुका है
scenes.image_brief: A glass of old grey cloudy vinegar with a thick white sediment layer settled at the bottom, the egg inside still partly shelled and unchanged, no bubbles anywhere, standing on the dark counter in flat light.

scenes.narration: That first glass did not fail him. It simply ran out.
scenes.caption: पहला ग्लास नाकाम नहीं हुआ। उसमें अम्ल बस चुक गया था
scenes.image_brief: Two glasses compared side by side on the dark counter, the left holding spent murky vinegar with a half shelled egg and the right holding clear fresh vinegar with a bare translucent egg, even kitchen light.

scenes.narration: Every reaction carries a budget of acid. Refill it or the change halts.
scenes.caption: हर क्रिया के पास अम्ल का बजट है। भरें वरना बदलाव रुक जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A glass measuring jug half emptied of vinegar standing beside a full unopened bottle on the dark counter, one bare translucent egg resting on a folded white cloth next to them, warm light from the window.

scenes.narration: Set two glasses up tonight. Change the vinegar in one, compare tomorrow.
scenes.caption: आज दो ग्लास लगाएँ। एक का सिरका बदलें, कल तुलना करें
scenes.image_brief: Two tall glasses of fresh white vinegar set side by side on a clean kitchen counter, one whole white egg in each, a strip of paper tape stuck to the rim of the right glass, bright morning light.

title: 🌈 Sana's liquid tower keeps mixing... the pour that ruins the layers #science #density
title_alts: 🍯 Sana stacks honey, water and oil... one spoon keeps them apart #science #density
🥄 Sana poured her density tower too fast... here is what that costs #science #density
description_hook: Honey, water and oil will stack themselves in one glass. Sana kept getting brown soup, and the liquids were never the problem.
setting: a white kitchen table holding jars and tall glasses

characters.name: Sana
characters.description: ten years old, long plaited hair, yellow raincoat she wears indoors, a teaspoon tucked behind her ear

claims.claim: Honey sits near 1.4 grams per millilitre
claims.basis: standard reference density for table honey, which varies a little with water content
the density of water in grams per millilitre is one by definition of the unit
typical density of common cooking oils, rounded for illustration

scenes.narration: Honey, water and oil will stack themselves in one glass.
scenes.caption: शहद, पानी और तेल एक ही ग्लास में खुद परतें बना लेते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A tall narrow glass on a white kitchen table holding three clean separated layers, thick golden honey at the bottom, clear water in the middle and pale yellow oil on top, bright side light making every boundary sharp.

scenes.narration: Sana pours all three in fast. She gets cloudy brown soup.
scenes.caption: साना ने तीनों तेज़ी से डाले। उसे गंदा भूरा घोल मिला
scenes.image_brief: A tall glass on the same white table filled with a cloudy brown mixture, streaks of honey and oil swirled through the water with no boundaries at all, an open honey jar and an oil bottle standing beside it, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Nothing separated. The tower she wanted collapsed before she finished pouring.
scenes.caption: कुछ अलग नहीं हुआ। उसका टावर डालते-डालते ही बैठ गया
scenes.image_brief: A murky glass of mixed liquids on the white table with a thin film of oil droplets floating on the surface and sticky honey streaks smeared down the inside of the glass, a wet ring on the table, dull light.

scenes.narration: You will learn the one movement that keeps the layers apart.
scenes.caption: आप वह एक हरकत सीखेंगे जो परतों को अलग रखती है
scenes.image_brief: A clean empty tall glass standing on the white table beside a metal teaspoon, with a jar of honey, a jug of water and a small bottle of cooking oil lined up behind it, bright morning light, everything ready and unused.

scenes.narration: Density is mass packed into volume. Heavier liquids sink below lighter ones.
scenes.caption: घनत्व यानी आयतन में भरा वज़न। भारी द्रव हल्के के नीचे जाता है
scenes.image_brief: Three identical small glasses on the white table, one holding only honey, one only water and one only oil, each filled to the same line, a digital kitchen scale standing behind them, even daylight.

scenes.narration: But a fast stream carries momentum, and momentum drills through the layer below.
scenes.caption: पर तेज़ धार में गति होती है, और वह नीचे की परत चीर देती है
scenes.image_brief: A thick stream of water falling fast from a jug straight into a glass of honey, the honey punching upward into a cloudy plume through the water, droplets landing on the white table, bright hard light.

scenes.narration: Honey sits near 1.4 grams per millilitre. Water is 1.0, oil about 0.9.
scenes.caption: शहद लगभग 1.4 ग्राम प्रति मिलीलीटर। पानी 1.0, तेल लगभग 0.9
scenes.image_brief: Three identical small glasses of honey, water and oil arranged in a row on a white table, the honey glass sitting on the pan of a digital kitchen scale, the other two waiting beside it, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Poured slowly down a tilted spoon, those three settle in that order.
scenes.caption: झुके चम्मच पर धीरे डालें तो तीनों उसी क्रम में बैठ जाते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A metal teaspoon resting tilted against the inside wall of a tall glass, oil trickling gently down its curved back onto a flat water layer, honey already settled at the bottom, three calm bands forming, soft window light.

scenes.narration: Spoon tricks cannot save liquids that dissolve into each other.
scenes.caption: चम्मच की चाल उन द्रवों को नहीं बचा सकती जो एक-दूसरे में घुल जाते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A glass of completely uniform clear liquid standing on the white table with a teaspoon leaning inside it, a salt shaker and a jug of water beside the glass, no boundary visible anywhere in the liquid, plain even light.

scenes.narration: Try salt water over fresh water and the boundary quietly disappears.
scenes.caption: नमक का पानी सादे पानी पर डालें, सीमा चुपचाप गायब हो जाती है
scenes.image_brief: Two glasses side by side on the white table, the left one showing three sharp bands of honey, water and oil, the right one holding a single clear liquid with no layers, a salt shaker standing in front of the right glass, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: The tower was never about the liquids she chose.
scenes.caption: टावर उसके चुने हुए द्रवों का मामला कभी नहीं था
scenes.image_brief: The finished three layer tower standing alone in the centre of the white table, honey, water and oil in crisp bands, warm late light passing through the glass and casting coloured stripes onto the table surface.

scenes.narration: It was about speed. Slow pouring lets density do the sorting.
scenes.caption: बात रफ़्तार की थी। धीमी धार घनत्व को अपना काम करने देती है
scenes.image_brief: A jug tipped at a shallow angle pouring a thin slow trickle of water down the back of a teaspoon into a glass, the honey layer below staying flat and undisturbed, calm even light across the white table.

scenes.narration: Pour your next layer onto the back of a spoon. Watch it hold.
scenes.caption: अगली परत चम्मच की पीठ पर डालें। देखें वह कैसे टिकती है
scenes.image_brief: A teaspoon, a tall glass holding two settled layers of honey and water, and a small jug of oil waiting beside it on the white table, bright daylight, the next pour not yet started.

title: 🧲 Dhruv's nail electromagnet lifts nothing... the wire mistake behind it #science #magnets
title_alts: ⚡ Dhruv's coiled nail becomes a magnet... the turns decide everything #science #magnets
🔩 Dhruv blamed the battery for a weak electromagnet... count the turns #science #magnets
description_hook: One nail, one battery, one wire, and nothing moves. The strength was never in the battery Dhruv kept replacing.
setting: a grey workbench scattered with nails, wire and paperclips

characters.name: Dhruv
characters.description: thirteen years old, buzzcut hair, orange hoodie with frayed cuffs, a pencil stub behind one ear

claims.basis: round illustrative coil count, stated as such in the narration
round illustrative coil count, stated as such in the narration
round illustrative result for a single cell nail electromagnet

scenes.narration: A single nail and some wire can lift a steel paperclip.
scenes.caption: एक कील और थोड़ा तार मिलकर स्टील का पेपरक्लिप उठा सकते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A steel nail wrapped in a few turns of red insulated copper wire lying on a grey workbench, one steel paperclip clinging to the nail tip and lifted clear of the bench, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: Dhruv wound wire loosely around a nail, ten turns, and nothing moved at all.
scenes.caption: ध्रुव ने कील पर ढीला तार लपेटा, दस लपेटें, और कुछ भी नहीं हिला
scenes.image_brief: An iron nail with about ten loose sagging turns of red copper wire around it, the wire ends taped to a single small battery, a pile of steel paperclips lying untouched on the grey workbench nearby, flat light.

scenes.narration: You will learn what those turns actually do to the magnet's strength.
scenes.caption: आप जानेंगे कि ये लपेटें चुंबक की ताक़त के साथ असल में क्या करती हैं
scenes.image_brief: Two nails resting side by side on the grey workbench, the left one carrying a loose untidy coil of red wire and the right one a dense tightly wound coil, a single battery lying between them, plain overhead light.

scenes.narration: Current through a wire makes a weak magnetic field circling all around it.
scenes.caption: तार में बहता करंट उसके चारों ओर हल्का चुंबकीय क्षेत्र बना देता है
scenes.image_brief: A straight length of red insulated copper wire lying across a grey workbench with a small pocket compass set beside it, the compass needle pulled sideways off north, the wire ends taped to a battery, even light.

scenes.narration: Coil that wire and every loop adds its own field to the next.
scenes.caption: उस तार को लपेटें तो हर फेरा अपना क्षेत्र अगले में जोड़ देता है
scenes.image_brief: A nail wrapped in neat closely packed turns of red copper wire filling its whole middle section, the wire ends taped to a battery, the nail resting in a small wooden cradle on the workbench, cool light.

scenes.narration: Ten loose turns barely tugged. Dhruv rewound them tight, one hundred turns.
scenes.caption: दस ढीली लपेटें बस हिलीं। ध्रुव ने कसकर सौ लपेटें लपेटीं
scenes.image_brief: A nail buried under a hundred tight turns of red copper wire so the metal is almost hidden, a loose tangle of leftover wire beside it, a battery taped to the coil ends, bright workbench light.

scenes.narration: Same battery, same nail, same paperclips, and now it lifts eleven of them.
scenes.caption: वही बैटरी, वही कील, वही पेपरक्लिप, और अब यह ग्यारह उठा लेता है
scenes.image_brief: A tightly wound nail electromagnet suspended above a small tray of steel paperclips with a hanging cluster of eleven paperclips clinging from its tip, the battery taped to the wire ends, bright workbench light.

scenes.narration: More turns also means more resistance, so the wire warms up fast.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादा लपेटें यानी ज़्यादा प्रतिरोध, इसलिए तार जल्दी गरम हो जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A tightly coiled nail electromagnet lying on the grey workbench with faint heat haze rising from it, the red insulation darkened and slightly shiny in one patch, a fallen paperclip beside it, dim light.

scenes.narration: That strength never came from the battery he kept blaming.
scenes.caption: यह ताक़त उस बैटरी से नहीं आई जिसे वह दोष देता रहा
scenes.image_brief: Three small batteries standing in a row alone on the grey workbench beside a bare unwound nail and a spool of red wire, nothing connected to anything, cool even light, quiet and unremarkable.

scenes.narration: It came from geometry. Same current, stacked one hundred times over.
scenes.caption: वह बनावट से आई। वही करंट, सौ बार एक पर एक रखा हुआ
scenes.image_brief: A nail covered end to end in a hundred dense turns of red copper wire lying on the grey workbench, the coil packed so tightly the turns touch, a cluster of paperclips held at the tip, even light.

scenes.narration: Count your turns before the next try. Then double them and measure again.
scenes.caption: अगली कोशिश से पहले लपेटें गिनें। फिर दोगुनी करें और दोबारा नापें
scenes.image_brief: A bare nail, a spool of red insulated wire, one small battery and a neat pile of steel paperclips laid out in a row on a clean grey workbench, bright daylight, ready for the next attempt.
